crossRefs.note: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay…
But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the…
There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived…
and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and…
The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good…
Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
(but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave…
A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to…
But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

translations.web: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
translations.bsb: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
translations.kjv: Let ➔ not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
translations.asv: Let none be enrolled as a widow under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
